title: Runtime - Supports system level subtitles BBC APIs for Audio Description
product-requirement: The product will reflect the system level setting of audio described
specification: If the terminal supports remote controls with a audio description, they MUST implement a central setting store and expose the setting to BBC applications via audioDescriptionEnabled API.
assertion: Test passes if the the audioDescriptionEnabled APIs are set to be either true or false
